intent: A doctor reading a growth chart out loud: friendly, precise, one surprise per line.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, three one-line beats, punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Which country has the TALLEST people on average?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Which country has the tallest people on average?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: The Netherlands. The average Dutch man is nearly 183 centimetres tall, the tallest on Earth.
His great-grandfather was around 169. Thirteen centimetres gained in a single century.
American men were third tallest a century ago. Today they rank 37th.
And the growing has stopped. Dutch people born after 1980 are no taller than their parents.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: Tall story, true numbers. Follow us.
